title: Traveler's Gear

{{Infobox Item |image= File:BotW Traveler's Sword Icon.png |caption= A Traveler's Sword |pronunciation= |plural= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Defense }} |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} The {{Term/Store|Traveler's Gear|Traveler's Gear|Series, BotW}} is a recurring archetype of [[Weapon]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW}}{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 169}}{{Name Ref|TotK, AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Traveler's Gear is equipment used by travelers passing through the wilderness of [[Hyrule Kingdom]]. It is not especially strong or durable, and is designed to fend off wild [[Animal]]s and weak [[Monster]]s.{{Cite|{{Big|Traveler's Sword}}
A very common sword often kept by travelers to fend off small beasts. It's fairly durable, but a bit unreliable against monsters.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Traveler's Spear}}
A spear used mainly by travelers to fend off wolves and other beasts. It's easy to hold and simple to use.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Traveler's Shield}}
A sturdy shield loved by {{Typo|many an adventurer}}. It is made of animal hide and sturdy wood and is best suited to defending against weak monsters or animals.|Inventory|BotW}} Pieces of Traveler's Gear are composed of both metal and wood. Wooden Traveler's Gear will burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], can float on [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], cannot conduct [[Electricity]], do not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, and are unable to be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. The inverse is true of metallic Traveler's Gear. ====List of Equipment==== {| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; max-width:57.5em; text-align:center" |- !style="width:25%"| Item !style="width:10%"| Strength !style="width:10%"| Durability !style="width:55%"| Description |- | [[File:BotW Traveler's Sword Icon.png|link=]]
